name: Verify DYNAMIC TABLE maps displayed headers and FLEX TABLE excludes its header row

steps.name: $("#customers/By.xpath: ./thead/tr[th][last()]/*[self::th or self::td] | ./thead[not(tr/th)]/tr[last()]/*[self::th or self::td]") should have(Text Country OR any of elements to match [normalized header "Country"] predicate)
$("#customers/By.xpath: ./tbody/tr[td].findBy(Company = "Ernst Handel")/By.xpath: ./*[self::td or self::th][2]") should have([exact text "Austria", 5s])
$("#flex-customers/:scope > .flex-table-row:first-child > div") should have(Text Country OR any of elements to match [normalized header "Country"] predicate)
$("#flex-customers/:scope > .flex-table-row:first-child > div") should have(Exact texts [Company, Contact, Country])
$("#flex-customers/:scope > .flex-table-row:not(:first-child).findBy(Company = "Company")") should([exist, 600ms])
